ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails and networks involved in recent Minnesota fraud cases, including the $2.2M Medicaid fraud scheme and the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.
questions: What are the financial networks and trails involved in these cases?
How do these cases connect to larger patterns of fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a deeper understanding of the motivations and mechanisms behind these fraud cases, and potentially uncover larger patterns of corruption.
